mechanism_inventory: reentrancy via msg.sender.transfer in withdraw (CEI satisfied; transfer 2300 gas)
overflow in balanceOf arithmetic (Solidity ^0.4.18, no SafeMath)
missing invariant enforcement: totalSupply (this.balance) vs sum(balanceOf) divergence via forced ETH
cross-chain value correctness — no mint/burn hooks tying WZETA supply to ZetaChain accounting

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: Integer overflow in balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value (deposit) and balanceOf[dst] += wad (transferFrom). Solidity ^0.4.18 has no SafeMath; no overflow check. An address near uint256 max can wrap balanceOf to 0, destroying WZETA without recovering ETH.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Any address accumulating balanceOf near uint256 max; permissionless. Or malicious actor engineering overflow on a victim via repeated small transfers.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. balanceOf[attacker]==2^256-1. 2. deposit() msg.value=1. 3. balanceOf overflows to 0. 4. WZETA lost; ETH locked.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Overflowing address loses all WZETA + underlying ETH; totalSupply integrity drifts.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: += with no overflow guard in 0.4.18; balanceOf accounting; Medium (permanent loss/corruption), High if engineered on victim.

unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: withdraw(): balanceOf -= wad; msg.sender.transfer(wad); balance decremented before call (CEI satisfied); transfer forwards 2300 gas.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: On ZetaChain's EVM fork, is 2300 gas reliably capped/sufficient to re-enter? Source cannot confirm fork gas costs.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: If reentrant: caller drains contract ETH beyond balance.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Cross-chain value correctness — totalSupply() returns this.balance; forced ETH (selfdestruct) inflates totalSupply without balanceOf entry, diverging from sum(balanceOf)
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: totalSupply() returns this.balance; deposit only increments balanceOf by msg.value; no protection against forced ETH.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does ZetaChain cross-chain accounting rely on WZETA.totalSupply() as a supply oracle? If so, forced donation breaks it.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Cross-chain accounting integrity / downstream protocols using totalSupply.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: balanceOf[src] -= wad then balanceOf[dst] += wad on same slot nets zero; require(balanceOf[src]>=wad) prevents underflow.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Net identity; no extra tokens created.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: standard infinite-approval pattern (canonical WETH9); owner must explicitly set uint(-1).
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Requires owner's prior consent; user-choice risk not protocol flaw.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Overflow: no direct ETH gain (victim loses WZETA/ETH); reentrancy (unresolved): drains contract ETH.
impact_direction.victim_loses: Overflow: victim loses entire WZETA balance (ETH locked); cross-chain: downstream lose accounting correctness.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: sum(balanceOf)==this.balance can be violated by forced ETH; integer overflow breaks per-user integrity; reentrancy (if gas allows) breaks withdraw atomicity.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Overflow triggerable by any address accumulating tokens, no admin; cross-chain totalSupply griefing permissionless via selfdestruct.
